title: Redis: rotate TLS certs across all nodes
description: Forces a Vault Agent re-render + service reload across every Redis node. Captures the openssl serial before + after to verify the new cert was issued.

observe.what: table: hostname / old serial / new serial / error (blank) -- one row per node; durations sum to ~30-45s
matches the new serial reported by the CLI

whatProves: Vault Agent's template re-render mechanism is reliable; redis-server reload picks up the new keystore without dropping connections.
